title: Order of Operations | Algebra I, Unit 1, Lesson 2
description:
Why is 3 + 4 × 2 equal to 11 and not 14? Learn the order of operations: grouping symbols, exponents, multiplication and division left to right, then addition and subtraction left to right. Includes worked examples, the -3² vs (-3)² trap, and a practice problem.
